name: Picker wheel (iOS)
summary: A scrolling wheel for choosing one value from a short list, such as hours or a country. The selected row sits in a highlighted band.

anatomy.purpose: Highlighted row showing the chosen value.
A visible label outside the wheel.

variants.name: Single column
variants.use: One value such as a country.

whenToUse: Choosing from a short, ordered list on iOS.
whenNotToUse: Long lists: use a searchable list.
Android: use a dialog or dropdown.

keyboard: Swipe up or down changes the value.
notes: Provide the same input another way for motor-impaired users.
